title: Geometry - Lesson 9 Practice: Mixed Angle Reasoning
description: Practice solving missing angles with parallel lines, perpendicular lines, transversals, and organized reasons.

questions.question: Lines $r$ and $s$ are parallel. A transversal creates corresponding angles $\angle 1$ and $\angle 5$. If $m\angle 1 = 72^\circ$, what is $m\angle 5$?
questions.explanation: Corresponding angles formed by a transversal across parallel lines are congruent, so the measure stays 72°.

questions.question: $\angle A$ and $\angle B$ form a linear pair. If $m\angle A = 72^\circ$, what is $m\angle B$?
questions.explanation: A linear pair is supplementary, so $m\angle B = 180^\circ - 72^\circ = 108^\circ$.

questions.question: If two lines are perpendicular, every angle at their intersection measures $90^\circ$.
questions.explanation: Perpendicular lines form four right angles, and each right angle measures 90°.

questions.question: Same-side interior angles formed by parallel lines have measures $115^\circ$ and $x^\circ$. Find $x$.
questions.explanation: Same-side interior angles are supplementary, so $x = 180 - 115 = 65$.

questions.question: A right angle is split into two smaller angles. One angle is $34^\circ$. What is the other angle?
questions.explanation: The two parts of a right angle sum to 90°, so the missing angle is $90^\circ - 34^\circ = 56^\circ$.

questions.question: Vertical angles $\angle C$ and $\angle D$ are formed by intersecting lines. If $m\angle C = 127^\circ$, then $m\angle D = $____.
questions.explanation: Vertical angles are congruent, so the opposite angle also measures 127°.

questions.question: Parallel lines are cut by a transversal. $m\angle 1 = 64^\circ$. Angle 2 corresponds to angle 1, and angle 3 forms a linear pair with angle 2. Find $m\angle 3$ and give the reason.
questions.correctAnswer: $m\angle 3 = 116^\circ$. Angle 2 is 64° because corresponding angles are congruent, and angle 3 is supplementary to angle 2 because they form a linear pair.
questions.explanation: First copy 64° by corresponding angles. Then subtract from 180° because a linear pair is supplementary.

questions.question: A transversal makes a $42^\circ$ angle with a horizontal line. A vertical line is perpendicular to the horizontal line. What is the acute angle between the transversal and the vertical line? Explain.
questions.correctAnswer: $48^\circ$, because the horizontal and vertical lines form a 90° angle and $90^\circ - 42^\circ = 48^\circ$.
questions.explanation: The transversal splits a right angle into two complementary parts, so the missing acute angle is 48°.
